sub_indicators.label: Satellite data in weather services
sub_indicators.subject: data.satellite
sub_indicators.text: Meteorological use of satellite data: satellite data in weather services
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Integrated African Strategy on Meteorology asks for sustained access to geostationary and polar-orbiting satellites, WMO's observing standards and ISO 9001 certification for every national weather service.
criteria: A source from the past three years says the national weather service receives no satellite data.
The national meteorological service has a satellite receiving station or data stream installed, contracted or being upgraded.
The national meteorological service uses satellite data in its forecasts or nowcasting.
The national meteorological service issues early warnings or impact-based forecasts that draw on satellite data.
The national meteorological service holds ISO 9001 certification for its services.
